description: This PHP class 'AssignClaimController' is part of the OrangeHRM project, under the Claim plugin's Controller namespace. It extends AbstractVueController and manages the pre-rendering of a Vue component related to claim assignment, utilizing services like PayGradeService and traits for authentication and service container management.

classes.name: AssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller managing the assignment of claims, responsible for preparing Vue components with currency data and user information.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance used to retrieve currency information.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with currency data and authenticated employee number before rendering.
